_about: Hand-picked Commons photos and author credits (Paul, 2026-11-09). `file` replaces the Wikidata P18 image; `author` replaces the Commons metadata text when it is not a usable credit. Drafted with Claude Code on 2026-11-09 after looking at each photo and reading its Commons file page; reviewed=false until Paul checks it.

entries.basis: P18 'AmericanCockerSpaniel wb.jpg' has no author on Commons; the other P18 'Cocker Spaniel Puppy.jpg' is a derivative whose photographer is not named. Replacement: buff adult, head and shoulders, Mike Baird (Flickr), CC BY 2.0.
P18 'Basset Hound 600.jpg' has no author on Commons. Replacement: tricolour adult sitting, full body, Pohled 111, CC BY-SA 4.0.
P18 'ShetlandShpdogBlue2 wb.jpg' has no author on Commons. Replacement: sable female, head portrait, Linsenhejhej, CC BY-SA 3.0.

The P18 kept ('Miniature Poodle (Hungary).jpg') shows a miniature; the page covers every size and Parker's tree leaf is the standard poodle (SPOO). Replacement: cream standard poodle standing, full body, John Leslie (Flickr), CC BY 2.0.
